title: THE ‘NO MORES’ OF HEBREWS 10
theme: The finality of Christ’s sacrifice brings forgiveness and warns against willful apostasy.
proposition: Christ’s sufficient sacrifice removes sin, leaving no excuse to reject it and no alternative sacrifice for the apostate.
sermonQuestion: What do the four “no mores” of Hebrews 10 teach us about sin and Christ’s sacrifice?

outline.heading: NO MORE CONSCIENCE OF SINS AS FAR AS THE BELIEVER IS CONCERNED v. 2
NO MORE REMEMBRANCE OF SINS AS FAR AS GOD IS CONCERNED v. 17
NO MORE OFFERING FOR SINS AS FAR AS CHRIST IS CONCERNED v. 18
NO MORE SACRIFICE FOR SINS AS FAR AS THE APOSTATE IS CONCERNED v. 26
